FN-CXYP1WJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 379
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/14/2025
House Bill 379 as introduced could decrease individual income tax receipts to the Education
Trust Fund by an undetermined amount beginning in Fiscal Year 2026 dependent on the amount
of compensation of certain non-residents exempted from state income tax pursuant to this bill.
Page 1

FN-CXYP1WJ-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 379
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/16/2025
House Bill 379 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education could decrease
individual income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an undetermined amount
beginning in Fiscal Year 2026 dependent on the amount of compensation of certain
non-residents exempted from state income tax pursuant to this bill and the taxpayer's applicable
effective tax rate.
Page 1

FN-CXYP1WJ-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 379
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/28/2025
House Bill 379 as passed the House of Representatives could, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026,
decrease individual income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an undetermined amount
dependent on the amount of compensation of certain non-residents exempted from state income
tax pursuant to this bill and the taxpayer's applicable effective tax rate.
